characters.description: A silver-rank outworlder who enters the unstable Nitra Transformation Zone alone. With ordinary essence abilities suppressed, he relies on unusual outworlder powers to prevent a dimensional breach that could devastate Earth.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: A gold-rank operative from the US Network branches. He allows Jason to enter the Nitra zone and plans to investigate Jason's unusual abilities.
characters.name: Jack Gerling

characters.description: Jason's shadow familiar, serving as scout, transport, and combat support. Shade can form Jason's black aircraft but cannot manifest inside the essence-sealed Nitra zone.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: Jason's leech familiar. Although the Nitra zone seals active familiar abilities, Colin's passive benefits continue to provide Jason with regeneration.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: Jason's silver-rank formation specialist and operational partner. From outside the sealed zone, she follows his progress and helps his allies interpret changes in his magic.
characters.name: Farrah Hurin

characters.description: Jason's sister and a central member of his Earth-side family. She watches the changes in his cloud construct alongside her husband and daughter while Jason remains isolated inside the zone.
characters.name: Erika Asano

characters.description: Erika's daughter and Jason's niece. She is with her parents and Dawn when Jason's deepening connection to his cloud flask becomes visible from outside the zone.
characters.name: Emi

characters.description: Erika Asano's husband and Emi's father. He watches the changes in Jason's cloud construct with his family while Jason remains isolated inside the zone.
characters.name: Ian

characters.description: A constrained astral ally who recognizes the meaning of changes in Jason's magical equipment. She aids his family and associates while he works inside the Nitra zone.
characters.name: Dawn

characters.description: The Chinese Network commander at the Slovakia dome. She contributes ritual expertise to an attempt at entering the unstable zone safely.
characters.name: Li Li Mei

characters.description: One of Jason's established combat familiars and part of the familiar team he normally relies upon.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: A time-confluence holder whose higher-rank powers cannot change the past.
characters.name: Danielle Geller

characters.description: A diamond-rank servant of the Builder who enters the transforming Nitra space through a temporary portal. He presents his arrival as thanks for Jason preventing Earth's destruction.
characters.name: Shako

characters.description: Jason's grandmother, now bronze rank, and a practical voice in the Asano family. She warns that the extended family is too divided and compromised for Jason's domain to serve as a simple refuge.
characters.name: Yumi Asano

characters.description: A Global Defence Network liaison through whom Farrah sends intelligence about the conversion of civilians into lesser vampires and ghouls.
characters.name: Annabeth Tilden

characters.description: A Global Defence Network delegate who enters Jason's Slovakian domain for negotiations. He is openly hostile toward the ancient-vampire delegate because that vampire previously used blood to coerce him.
characters.name: Craig Vermillion

characters.description: A member of the Global Defence Network delegation that travels to Jason's Slovakian domain for negotiations.
characters.name: Akari Asano

characters.description: The EOA's leading organizer, first encountered here through an alternate body. He asks Jason to penetrate a sealed French astral facility that is producing enhanced blood, lesser vampires, and ghouls.
characters.name: Mr. North

characters.description: An EOA operative abducted by Gerling and compelled to provide access to the sealed French astral space. His ritual knowledge makes him important to Gerling's incursion.
characters.name: Adrien Barbou

characters.description: A young Category 2 Magitek specialist serving as acting head of a German base's special-munitions unit. His engineering knowledge is necessary to reach the secured arsenal.
characters.name: Magitek weapons engineer

characters.description: A silver-rank necromancer who channels power from an immense ghoul force. He trades control of his developing domain for amnesty and permission to conduct research under supervision.
characters.name: The necromancer

characters.description: A silver-rank necromancer whose vast ghoul army fuels his magic. When Jason contests his nascent domain, he bargains it away for amnesty and supervised access to research.
characters.name: Todd Halverson

characters.description: A gold-rank vampire who moderates the other vampires trapped in the French zone. She is the first among them to accept Jason's demand for cooperation against the dimensional catastrophe.
characters.name: Elizabeth

characters.description: A gold-rank vampire trapped within the French zone and one of the five vampires confronted by Jason.
characters.name: Wassily

characters.description: A gold-rank vampire trapped within the French zone alongside four others.
characters.name: Klaus

characters.description: A scholar of the Way of the Reaper. His research into a fallen order leads him to conclude that the complete combat style was designed to be acquired through skill books.
characters.name: Emir Bahadir

characters.description: An Asano clan co-administrator who shares responsibility with Yumi after Jason's departure. He helps oversee the clan's Earth-side affairs and its support for relocated non-humans.
characters.name: Shiro

characters.description: A silver-rank adventurer and defender of Greenstone who mourns Jason and Farrah as dead. He tries to bring Gareth back from isolation while building a new training annex.
characters.name: Rufus Remore

characters.description: A grieving smith who has abandoned adventuring after the presumed deaths of Jason and Farrah. Isolated and drinking heavily, he refuses Rufus's offer of advancement.
characters.name: Gareth Xandier

characters.description: A diamond-rank smith who recognizes Gareth's neglected talent. He forcibly recruits Gareth and directs his craft toward practical defenses for remote settlements facing growing monster attacks.
characters.name: Virid Martin

characters.description: A member of the group that reunites with Gareth while seeking equipment.
characters.name: Belinda Callahan

characters.description: A member of the group that reunites with Gareth while seeking equipment.
characters.name: Jory

characters.description: An adventurer investigating her origins in Kurdansk. Emir proposes using her connection to the region to draw out the Order of the Reaper, and she insists that accepting the danger is her choice.
characters.name: Sophie Wexler

characters.description: Sophie's adventuring partner. He objects to Emir's plan to use her history as bait and accompanies her as she pursues answers in Kurdansk.
characters.name: Humphrey Geller

characters.description: An adventurer who opposes the danger of Emir's Kurdansk plan. He later prepares to protect rural potion-teaching work as monster activity grows.
characters.name: Neil

characters.description: A veteran monster hunter at gold rank who once served on Emir's team. He is traveling with Constance while she pursues advancement to gold rank.
characters.name: Callum Morse

characters.description: Emir's chief of staff. She is away with Callum while pursuing advancement to gold rank.
characters.name: Constance

characters.description: An astral-magic researcher driven to pursue the Builder cult's portal network. He activates one of its portals inside the Rakesh research department and escapes before officials can stop him.
characters.name: Clive Standish

characters.description: A Rakesh research department vice dean responsible for bringing Clive into its astral-magic program.
characters.name: Lorelei Grantham

characters.description: A Magic Society official who tries to prevent Clive from leaving on a revenge-driven mission.
characters.name: Prani Ajus

characters.description: A dragon and longtime companion of the Geller family. Danielle brings Sophie and Humphrey to meet her as they seek a route toward Clive.
characters.name: Carlivexistrix
